name: better-me
description: 迈向更好 / BetterMe — local-first growth & career workstation

scripts.dev:isolated: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@better-me/web^... && pnpm --filter @better-me/web exec node dev-server.mjs --config tests/ui-lab/career-coach-live.config.ts
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web/src apps/web/server apps/web/vite.config.ts packages/core/src packages/storage/src packages/opportunities/src packages/source-adapters/src apps/job-service/src apps/agent-host/src --max-warnings 0
scripts.test: turbo run build --filter=@better-me/web^... && tsx --test --test-concurrency=4 packages/core/tests/*.test.mjs packages/storage/tests/*.test.ts packages/opportunities/tests/*.test.ts packages/source-adapters/tests/*.test.ts apps/job-service/tests/*.test.ts apps/agent-host/tests/*.test.ts apps/web/tests/*.test.ts apps/web/tests/*.test.tsx
